_README: CAPTURED, NOT WRITTEN. Regenerate with: cd backend && npm run capture:coldopen

original.request: Run a full marathon in 3 weeks, starting from never having run.

counter.statement: Run a full marathon 20 weeks from now — starting from zero running, building to a 4-day-a-week plan that peaks around 50-55 km/week and includes one long run that reaches 32 km.
counter.subtitle: The marathon is real — the 3 weeks isn't. Twenty weeks and you're in business.

risk.line: Zero running base is the whole risk, and it's already priced into the odds.
risk.detail: Going from never-run to 42.2 km in three weeks isn't a stretch goal, it's a stress fracture with a bib number. That's why the original ask scores near zero — and why the 20-week version scores 82 instead.
